**Please provide the following information when reporting a bug**

- [ ] Backend in use: Jellyfin or Subsonic
- [ ] Version of Gelly and package type: Flatpak or other
- [ ] Linux distro
- [ ] Approximate library size (number of songs)

Please also provide logs if relevant. Debug logging can be enabled by running Gelly with `RUST_LOG="debug,glycin=off,glycin_utils=off"`

Thank you for reporting bugs and helping improve Gelly!
